description:
Summary score for the PROMIS Sleep-Related Impairment instrument. Each item ranges from 1 to 5. The raw score is the sum of all 8 items. Higher score indicates more severe sleep related impairment.[Yu L et al, 2012 (PMID: 22250775)](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3261577/)

[Search for all PROMIS SRI variables within this dataset](https://sleepdata.org/loftdatasets/lofthf/variables?search=promissri)
